instructions.text: Create Quick Event accepts an event description and Return creates it. Open the created event to inspect the interpreted details.
Double-click an event to view details. Its detail editor supports notes, a URL, attachments, and time-related settings; choose the observed field matching the task.
To set an alert, open the event, select its time, then choose an option from the Alert menu.
Read back the event title, calendar, start and end date/time, and all-day or time-zone settings relevant to the task. Natural-language entry can resolve a date differently than intended.

provenance.evidence: Project workflow guidance, not validated live in this app. Proposed check of structured event details after quick entry; not a claim of natural-language parser reliability.

instructions.text: When a created event has incorrect details, edit that event and recheck it. Avoid creating another event merely because the calendar view changed or the detail panel closed.

provenance.evidence: Project workflow guidance, not validated live in this app. Proposed recovery rule to prevent duplicate events after uncertain outcomes.

instructions.text: Attendees turn an event into a communication workflow. Match any selected invitees to the task, and verify the final event after the authorized save or invitation action.

provenance.evidence: Project workflow guidance, not validated live in this app. Task-scope and result check for calendar invitations; app instructions do not themselves authorize inviting anyone.
